summary.headline: BKT signs Pirelli offtake deal to produce 800,000 Pirelli-branded premium car tires per year by 2030 at Bhuj PCR plant, starting CY2027.
summary.overview: This was a short business update call on the Pirelli-BKT strategic offtake agreement, held at short notice, with Q2 FY27 performance explicitly off-limits under the silent-period policy. BKT will manufacture Pirelli-branded car tires (17-inch and above) at its newly built Bhuj PCR plant, ramping gradually from CY2027 to 800,000 tires per year by CY2030. A second phase contemplates a 50:50 JV and a dedicated plant for high-value passenger car tires, subject to preset conditions, with management saying the JV work must be announced by 2030. Management said the offtake fits within the existing expansion programme, with no additional capex for the offtake, and pricing is raw material at actuals plus conversion cost.

Roughly 350-355 operating days per year assumed

Company blended EBITDA margin cited by analyst

segments.name: Passenger car tires (PCR) - Pirelli offtake
segments.commentary: Contract manufacturing of Pirelli-branded 17-inch and above car tires at Bhuj, using Pirelli-specific specs; pricing on raw material actuals plus conversion cost, so BKT earns conversion margin. Majority of volume expected for India, with some for Pirelli's global markets.

segments.name: Passenger car tires (PCR) - BKT brand
segments.commentary: Bulk of Phase 1 capacity (about 80% of 6,700 tires/day) stays on BKT brand, addressing the full Indian market from 13-inch upward. BKT is at an early stage of its on-highway journey.

segments.name: Carbon black
segments.commentary: Management said BKT's carbon black business benefits because Pirelli tires made at BKT will use BKT-branded carbon black.

guidance_outlook: Offtake to commence in CY2027, scaling to 800,000 Pirelli-branded tires per year by CY2030.
Offtake investment is part of the existing expansion programme; no additional capex for the offtake, but JV plant would need additional investment.
Pirelli volumes count toward the existing FY30 target of about 20% of revenue from non-OHT (new on-road) categories.
Margin policy unchanged per management: the company's stated policy is to maintain margins despite the 20% non-OHT target.
Vision 2030 reiterated; management said the partnership gives more confidence in achieving it.
JV timing not disclosed; the JV is to be announced by 2030, subject to preset Phase 1 conditions.
capex_capacity: Bhuj PCR plant is newly constructed with equipment management said is nearly identical to Pirelli's own plants; no further capex needed for the offtake per management.
Phase 1 capacity is 6,700 tires per day, with infrastructure that can expand multifold modularly based on demand traction.
Management declined to give a percentage of 2030 capacity that the 800,000 tires would occupy, citing modular expansion.
JV plant: timeline and capex not disclosed; management said it is too early to comment and declined to say whether the JV will be completed by CY29 or CY30.
demand_pricing: Pirelli targets the very high-end Indian car market, which management described as about 10% of the total market; Indian passenger car market growing at 6% to 7% annually.
Pricing is raw material at actuals plus conversion cost on domestic supplies; BKT's earnings are the conversion margin.
Management declined to share Pirelli's market share in India or the minimum offtake volumes, calling them confidential.

Management said there is no royalty payable in the JV; a separate service agreement covers testing and simulation use of Pirelli infrastructure for BKT-branded products, for a consideration not disclosed.
Management said BKT would not get access to Pirelli's technology or designs; each company keeps its own IP, with a clear partition between Pirelli-branded and BKT-branded production.

qa_highlights.question: What investment is needed for the Bhuj capacity and the Pirelli ramp-up?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the offtake is part of the ongoing expansion programme already announced last year; the JV would need additional investment, but no timeline or amount was given.

qa_highlights.question: Will the Pirelli deal be part of the 20% non-OHT revenue target for FY30?
qa_highlights.answer: Yes, Pirelli revenue counts within the existing 20% non-OHT target; management said conviction in the Vision 2030 target has increased.

qa_highlights.question: Does BKT get access to Pirelli's technology, designs or SKUs?
qa_highlights.answer: No. Management said BKT will use its own technology and designs for its own products, and there will be a clear partition between Pirelli and BKT production.

qa_highlights.question: Is there a royalty payable to Pirelli?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said there is no royalty and none was discussed. A separate service agreement covers Pirelli testing and simulation infrastructure for BKT products, for consideration.

qa_highlights.question: Will Pirelli's distribution network be available to BKT?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said distribution stays with each brand's own team; the tie-up is expected to ease channel acceptance for BKT car tires, not to share distribution.

qa_highlights.question: How many operating days should be assumed for 6,700 tires per day?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said roughly 350 to 355 days per year.

risks_watch: Ramp-up pace and quantum of the 800,000 tires by CY2030 are not formally committed; minimum offtake volumes are confidential.
JV terms, timing, capex and the preset conditions are undisclosed; management declined to say whether the JV will be done by 2030.
Margin impact of the Pirelli conversion-based pricing has not been quantified; management declined to give revenue or margin potential by 2030.
Dilution risk to BKT's own car-tire positioning in the premium segment, since both brands share the same facility, though management said the brands differ in technology and price points.
Export mix and use of Bhuj output for Pirelli's global markets remain unclear.
summary.management_tone: Confident and upbeat on the strategic validation, but guarded on numbers: management declined to give JV timelines, capex, margins, minimum offtake volumes and Pirelli's market share, citing confidentiality and early stage. Q2 results were not discussed under the silent-period policy.
key_quotes: This partnership combines the technological and innovation prowess of Pirelli, along with the industrial capabilities of BKT, to create a strong foundation to serve one of the fastest-moving and growing auto markets of the globe.
We do not want to rely on any third-party partner for their own technology or designs. We will make everything on our own.
So, the equipment technology and everything that we have put into place is capable of, I mean, these are almost the same equipments that Pirelli has in their plants.
There is no royalty. We have never spoken about any royalty.
